title: BIAS AND FAIRNESS IN CHATBOTS: AN OVERVIEW

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis of chatbot interface feminization, sexual harassment responses, word embedding stereotypes, and topic representation in large language models.
Literature review and conceptual analysis of allocation harms, such as algorithmic disparities in healthcare and medical decision-making.
Literature review of model stereotypes triggered by specific user prompts, such as associating 'Muslim' with 'Terrorist'.
Literature review examining how language identification tools and NLP models misinterpret or exhibit bias against dialects and informal language.
Literature review discussing existing empirical studies on the political leanings of LLMs, such as biases against conservatives.
